confidence_notes: I made 5 web searches and found little Tottori-specific data. The RBA rate came from one search that read the RBA exchange-rate pages. Beer is supported by an izakaya draft listing at about ¥660 and an aggregator figure of about $3.92. Meal prices come from aggregator sites that disagree: about $9 for an inexpensive meal and about $31–34 for two at mid-range. I found no Tottori cappuccino price, only nearby café drink ranges of ¥300–700. I found no Tottori cocktail or wine prices, so cocktail is based on a highball at about ¥550 and izakaya drinks at ¥300–600, plus a bar premium. Wine is set slightly above beer. I converted yen to USD at roughly ¥155 per USD, which is an assumption and not from a search. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of a small Japanese prefectural capital with few hostels and mostly business hotels. They are not based on listings or booking pages. Hostel and 1-star figures are the most uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other small regional Japanese cities such as Matsue, Yonago and Tsuyama, which are cheaper than Tokyo or Osaka and have similar business-hotel-dominated lodging.
